items.summary: It wasn't immediately clear the extent of the damage hackers might have been able to cause, and Binance had not explicitly confirmed that funds had been pilfered. The company said its teams are "working around the clock" to resolve the issue.

items.title: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
items.summary: Alaska's governor ordered an investigation into claims that Dems recruited a spoiler candidate to confuse voters. And, Hegseth ousted an Army general as the U.S. prepares for potential attacks on Iran.

items.title: Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts
items.summary: The euro zone showed surprising resilience, but weak productivity, industrial competitiveness challenges and demographic pressures remain, analysts said.

items.title: Wall Street braces for Democratic gains as 2026 midterm election nears
items.summary: Investors are preparing for a blue wave in the midterm election on Tuesday that will determine who controls Congress for the remainder of President Trump's term.

items.title: Russia: Critical newspaper 'Novaya Gazeta' to close
items.summary: "Novaya Gazeta," one of the last remaining independent, critical media outlets in Russia, has announced it is closing under pressure from state authorities. Meanwhile, in Ukraine, evacuations have begun in Oleshky.
